nodes.name: Review Webhook
nodes.notes: El dueño llega aquí desde el link del email (?batch=…&token=…). Sin token válido no se muestra nada.

parameters.query:
SELECT b.batch_id, b.status, b.expires_at, (b.expires_at < now()) AS expired, now() AS now_utc,
  COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
      'id', d.id, 'contact_id', d.contact_id, 'contact_name', c.name, 'email', c.email, 'company', c.company, 'phone', c.phone,
      'timezone', c.timezone, 'touch', d.touch, 'kind', d.kind, 'status', d.status, 'body_core', d.body_core, 'blocked_reason', d.reason
    ) ORDER BY d.id)
    FROM revival_drafts d JOIN revival_contacts c ON c.contact_id = d.contact_id WHERE d.batch_id = b.batch_id), '[]'::jsonb) AS drafts
FROM revival_batches b
WHERE b.batch_id = $1 AND b.review_token = $2

nodes.name: Apply Review
nodes.notes: DETERMINÍSTICO y fail-closed: sin elección clara = no se envía. Un texto editado con links o promesas de precio se salta con su motivo; el pie de baja se agrega siempre.

parameters.query:
WITH b AS (
  UPDATE revival_batches SET status = 'approved', decided_at = now()
  WHERE batch_id = $1 AND review_token = $2 AND status = 'pending_review' AND expires_at > now() RETURNING batch_id
), d AS (
  UPDATE revival_drafts d SET status = x.status, body_core = x.body_core, body = x.body, edited = x.edited, reason = x.reason, decided_at = now()
  FROM jsonb_to_recordset($3::jsonb) AS x(id bigint, status text, body_core text, body text, edited boolean, reason text)
  WHERE d.id = x.id AND d.batch_id = $1 AND d.status = 'pending_review' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM b)
  RETURNING d.id, d.status
)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM b) AS batch_updated, (SELECT count(*) FROM d) AS drafts_updated, $4::jsonb AS state

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [$json.batch, $json.token, JSON.stringify($json.decisions.map(d => ({ id: d.id, status: d.status, body_core: d.body_core, body: d.body, edited: d.edited, reason: d.reason }))), JSON.stringify($json)] }}

nodes.name: Persist Review
nodes.notes: UNA sentencia atómica: el lote pasa a approved SOLO si seguía pending_review y no vencido; un doble envío del formulario no duplica nada.

nodes.name: Expand Approved
nodes.notes: Un ítem por borrador aprobado. Send Touch re-comprueba TODO antes de enviar (lote aprobado, bajas, orden, horario).

nodes.name: Dispatch Send
nodes.notes: Llamada INTERNA, de a un borrador por segundo. 202 = aceptado o diferido por horario, 409 = bloqueado por la guarda, 200 = duplicado.

nodes.name: Assert Dispatch
nodes.notes: Si algún despacho falla, el borrador sigue aprobado y la cola de envío (Send Queue) lo reintenta; además salta la alerta.

parameters.content:
## Revival · Review Page
The owner opens the link from the email, sees the REAL drafts, and for each lead can send, edit or skip. Only what is explicitly sent is dispatched. Expired or reused links change nothing.

### Per-step log → Postgres
Nodes "Log · …": side branches.
